name: Max HelpDesk
description_en:
Max HelpDesk is a product in the Help desk category. Its directory profile covers Multi-Channel Communication, Ticket Management, Known Issue Management, Self Service Portal, Live Chat.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $9.0. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: coordinate conversations across supported channels; create, assign and track service requests; exchange messages with visitors or customers in real time. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
